name: Bitwise Geometric Obfuscation
description: Transforms the base-100 exact cover into a base-2 geometric sum using bitwise left-shift operators. Because k paths contribute exactly 3k bits, achieving a target with exactly 3k bits set mathematically strictly forbids any binary carries. This silently preserves the exact cover requirement while appearing to be a coupled subset-sum problem with carries, tricking models into abandoning Algorithm X for generic DP or ILP solvers.
